title: Towards Auditing Large Language Models: Improving Text-based Stereotype Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Probing LLMs with a prompt library derived from the Multi-Grain Stereotype (MGS) dataset and evaluating the generated text completions for gender stereotypes using a fine-tuned Distil-BERT multi-class classifier.
